components.name: Word Tag
components.description: Signature: paper-stock tag with cut, folded corner; inverts to ink once used.
components.css: .ds-li{display:flex;width:150px;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 1px oklch(30% 0.05 80/.12)) drop-shadow(0 4px 8px oklch(30% 0.05 80/.1))}.ds-tag{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:76px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:2px;padding:14px 14px 12px;text-align:left;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:var(--tag);color:var(--ink);clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 20px) 0,100% 20px,100% 100%,0 100%);transform:rotate(var(--tilt));transition:transform 180ms var(--ease-out),background-color 200ms ease,color 200ms ease}.ds-tag::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:20px;height:20px;background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--tag) 78%,black);clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 100%,0 100%)}.ds-tag:hover{transform:rotate(0) translateY(-2px)}.ds-tag:active{transform:rotate(0) scale(.97)}.ds-tag:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-tag-used{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}.ds-tag-used::before{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--ink) 70%,white)}.ds-kind{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75}.ds-word{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.15}

components.name: Writing Surface
components.description: Grain-textured card with notebook ruling; cobalt halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-writer{background:var(--grain),var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-1);display:flex;min-height:168px;transition:border-color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease}.ds-writer:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)}.ds-writer textarea{flex:1;width:100%;resize:none;border:0;outline:0;background-color:transparent;padding:16px;border-radius:16px;font:1.0625rem/1.6 var(--font-ui);color:var(--ink);background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0,transparent calc(1.6em - 1px),var(--rule) calc(1.6em - 1px),var(--rule) 1.6em);background-position:0 16px;background-attachment:local}.ds-writer textarea::placeholder{color:var(--ink-3)}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Login and form field with label.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px}.ds-field label{font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-2)}.ds-field input{min-height:52px;padding:0 16px;font-size:1.0625rem;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;outline:0;transition:border-color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:var(--ink-3)}

narrative.overview:
A sheet of warm cream paper that hands you four paper tags each morning. Everything else is quiet stationery: blue-black ink for type, one fountain-pen cobalt for actions, soft cards with layered shadows, a faint paper grain. The single idea the system owns is the word tag; it is tappable, paper-stock colored, and turns to ink once the word is used.

The system is calm, tactile and small-handed. It is built for short phone sessions: one column, big touch targets, no dashboards or metrics competing with the writing box. The category's familiar shell (bottom tab bar, single-column editor, month-grid calendar) is kept on purpose; the personality lives in material, type and the tag.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream paper tinted toward the ink's blue, never flat grey; paper grain via a generated SVG noise tile (no raster files).
One cobalt accent for actions and the active tab; the streak flame is the only warm color.
Young Serif for words, headings and wordmark; Hanken Grotesk for everything else.
Four paper-stock tag colors (rose, butter, sage, sky), used only on word tags.
Layered soft shadows; a 480px phone-width sheet centered on larger screens.
Light theme only; no dark theme exists.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only accent. Do not add a second action color.

rules.name: The Lone Flame Rule
rules.body: The flame hue belongs to the streak. No other element may be warm-saturated.

rules.name: The Tags-Only Rule
rules.body: Rose, butter, sage and sky exist only on word tags.

rules.name: The Words Are Serif Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a prompt word, heading or identity is Young Serif; anything tappable as an action is Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The Paper Material Rule
rules.body: Writing surface, calendar and sheet carry the grain tile (feTurbulence SVG data URI, 180px, 7% alpha); the writing textarea additionally carries notebook ruling, one line per line box (1.6em), in a pale blue rule that scrolls with the text.

dos: **Do** keep cobalt (oklch(47% 0.2 268)) as the only action color and use Cobalt Wash for selected and focus fills.
**Do** reserve the flame hue for the streak and the four pastel tag colors for tags.
**Do** set prompt words, headings and identity in Young Serif and all operable UI in Hanken Grotesk.
**Do** give every pressable control a `scale(0.97)` press on the strong ease-out, hover effects gated to `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
**Do** keep text inputs at 17px, touch targets at 40px or more, and placeholder or fine print at Ink Faint or darker.
**Do** tint shadows warm and layer two of them; carry depth with a 1px Pencil Line border as well.
**Do** draw icons in the one stroke family (24px grid, 1.75 stroke, round caps) as inline SVG.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent, a gradient accent, or warm saturation outside the streak.
**Don't** use grey cards, pure black or white, or a hard offset shadow; paper and ink stay tinted.
**Don't** introduce a hero metric or a chat-style editor; the writing box is a ruled page.
**Don't** use a system display face for headings; Georgia is a fallback only.
**Don't** drive layout from width breakpoints beyond the 480px sheet; compactness follows height (760px).
**Don't** animate layout properties or let the keyboard cause a layout shift on focus.
